items.title: Show HN: We made a new theme to increase engagement on our website
items.contentSnippet:
Backstory: We run an old-internet-style website called ZenMemes.
Recently, end-user testing has shown that many users find this site disorienting, because there is no cookie banner, and at no point are you told the experience is better in the app.
To help them adapt, we built a new theme called Engagify. We made this page default to the theme so it's easier to test out.

items.title: Show HN: Jacq, a DSL that compiles model and kernel descriptions to CUDA
items.contentSnippet:
I was working (with agents) on testing out various attention algorithm ideas I had, and I found that the existing infrastructure/libraries made it more difficult than it should be.
So I created Jacq, a DSL and compiler. A jacq file describes a model’s configuration, weights, layers, and pipeline. Jacq turns it into a standalone CUDA inference runtime and a Python weight exporter. Kernel descriptions can also generate CUDA harnesses.
